reason: I might try the free version, but I would not pay. I do throw out vegetables every week, but scanning receipts means handing over my family's shopping and data to an app, and I have no reason to believe the promise.
objection: I don't trust an app with my family's data. Anyone can write 'never sold' and I can't check it. And I order on Talabat and Noon, so I'm not even holding supermarket receipts half the time.
would_change_my_mind: If my delivery-app orders came in on their own without me scanning anything, and the free version kept working for months with no card and nothing odd asked of me.
